result_text:
I changed the `all_files.zip` export so each scope's file list is looked up and named from its configured aspect name, not from fixed strings. It compiles, but I didn't run any tests or an export. So the renamed case (`aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt` in the fourth place, plus `git-history.zip`) is untested.

The change is in `DataExporter.java`, in the block that writes `all_files.zip`. It takes the five scope aspects (main, test, generated, build and deployment, other) in that order. For each one it gets the entry name from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same call that writes the loose `aspect_<name>.txt` files. It then reads that file from the text folder and uses the same name as the zip entry.

With the default configuration the entries should keep their current names and order. I didn't check that against the code that builds the names.

When the lookup name matches the written name, the read no longer fails. That failure was what aborted the export before `all_files.zip` and `git-history.zip` were written.
